messages:
Alex (Security): Heads-up — external assessment scheduled Apr 12 09:00 PDT. Scope: KMS proxy, RBAC admin paths, audit logging/traces. Need a short live‑fire contingency runbook, evidence packaging owner, and retest windows. Who can own?
Maria (SecOps): I can own evidence packaging and manifest. Need confirmation on log export TTL and whether we provide presigned links or a reading room.
Jordan (SRE): Presigned S3 + read-only role is easiest. Also recommend enabling verbose audit for the window (increase retention to 90d for those logs).
Sam (Eng-Infra): Question on KMS: will assessors use our KMS-proxy with a read-only decrypt key, or bring their own key? If ours, we need a key policy and to disable rotation during the window.
Alex (Security): Assessors requested our proxy for telemetry correlation. Maria — can you draft the key policy snippet and an RBAC exception for ephemeral assessor roles?
Maria (SecOps): Drafted policy snippet below, will push to the evidence JIRA.
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AssessorReadOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-ephemeral"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Jordan (SRE): Add a condition to restrict by IP range for the assessor bastion 203.0.113.0/24. Also define log-sampling: full traces for 09:00-09:30 then 10% afterwards unless triggered.
Lee (Oncall): Runbook note: if an exploit is detected during assessment, triage severity >= P1 -> immediate bridge, disable assessors' ephemeral role, snapshot VM, and escalate to incident response. I’ll add a quick checklist. Link: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/live-fire-contingency :eyes:
assessor-bot: Access window scheduled Apr 12 09:00-12:00 PDT. Ephemeral creds will be issued 10m before start.
Sam (Eng-Infra): I will provision the assessor-ephemeral role and create s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4201234567/ with presigned links TTL 24h. Will also create a temp CloudTrail bucket with 90d retention.
Maria (SecOps): Manifest prepared: artifacts_manifest.csv (listing screenshots, exports, traceroutes, stack snapshots). Uploaded to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4201234567/manifest.csv
Alex (Security): Thanks. Retest windows proposed: Apr 15 morning or Apr 19 afternoon. Which works?
Jordan (SRE): Apr 19 13:00 PDT preferred — gives us time to implement any hotfixes from the initial run.
Alex (Security): Locking Apr 19 13:00 PDT for retest. I’ll create invites and add the retest checklist to the JIRA.
Sam (Eng-Infra): One more — for RBAC changes during the window, please label PRs with pt:changes and add the CI audit tag so they get recorded in our audit-index.
Maria (SecOps): Will do. Also toggling verbose audit mode for iam, kms, and storage from Apr 12 08:45 to Apr 12 12:30.
Jordan (SRE): Confirmed. I’ll run a dry export at Apr 11 17:00 to validate the pipeline.
Alex (Security): Great — owners: Maria evidence, Sam infra provisioning, Jordan SRE exports/retention, Lee oncall. Assessor access finalized by assessor-bot. If anything urgent before the window ping me. :thumbsup:
